items.headline: U.S. Futures Mixed Ahead of Fed Decision; AI Enthusiasm Continues
items.summary: U.S. stock futures showed a mixed performance on Wednesday as investors awaited the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision, widely expected to be a hold, and upcoming earnings reports from tech giants. The AI-powered semiconductor sector continued to demonstrate momentum, influencing broader market sentiment. Rising oil prices following an attack on a Saudi refinery also contributed to market dynamics. Not financial advice.

items.headline: Federal Reserve to Announce Interest Rate Decision Today
items.summary: The Federal Reserve's Open Market Committee (FOMC) concludes its meeting today, October 28, 2026, with an interest rate decision expected at 2:00 PM ET, followed by a press conference at 2:30 PM ET. Markets widely anticipate the central bank will hold rates steady, though any signals about future policy will be closely watched.

items.headline: Mega-Cap Tech Earnings on Tap After Market Close
items.summary: Investors are keenly awaiting third-quarter earnings reports from tech giants Microsoft ($MSFT) and Alphabet ($GOOGL, $GOOG) after the market closes today. These reports are expected to provide significant insights into the health of the technology sector and the ongoing impact of AI investments.

items.headline: AI-Powered Semiconductor Sector Continues Momentum
items.summary: The AI-powered semiconductor space showed strong momentum yesterday, with the PHLX Semiconductor Index ($SOX) advancing 3.6% and the iShares Semiconductor ETF ($SOXX) appreciating 3.9%. This positive trend continues to influence market sentiment today, with chip stocks generally outperforming.

items.headline: Oil Prices Climb Following Saudi Refinery Attack
items.summary: Oil prices rose on Wednesday after an attack on a Saudi refinery revived concerns about supply disruptions in the Middle East. This geopolitical development is influencing the energy sector and broader market sentiment.

items.headline: Strong Durable Goods and Consumer Confidence Data Released
items.summary: The U.S. Census Bureau reported that durable goods orders increased by 1.8% month-over-month in September, marking the fastest growth in five months. Additionally, the Conference Board's Consumer Confidence Index rose by 7.5 points to 91.7 in October, exceeding estimates and showing the first monthly rise in four months.

items.headline: Frontier Airlines Reports Record Q3 Revenue
items.summary: Frontier Group Holdings, Inc. ($ULCC) announced record third-quarter 2026 revenue of approximately $1.4 billion, a 53% increase year-over-year. The company also provided guidance for the fourth quarter.

items.headline: American Electric Power Expands Capital Plan After Strong Q3
items.summary: American Electric Power ($AEP) reported strong third-quarter 2026 earnings, leading the company to expand its five-year capital plan to $100 billion and increase its long-term growth outlook, driven by accelerating electricity demand.
